verdict.rationale: Bench is a hosted, human-plus-software bookkeeping service. The core is its online app plus a professional bookkeeping and tax team. The evidence contains no mention of a self-hostable, on-premises, or open-source deployment. Self-hosting is a fair question for software in this category, so the absence of evidence makes this 'none' rather than 'na'.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
